scenarios.title: Plan a safe community sports demonstration
scenarios.brief: Create a short supervised sports demonstration for a small audience. Explain the body-system idea, select safe movement drills, prepare a readable one-page instruction card, rehearse a short spoken introduction and create a guardian-approved logistics/check-in plan.
deliverables: risk-checked movement sequence and stop rules
scenarios.evidence: Learner explains choices, shows safe practice under appropriate supervision, tests visual readability with a peer and records source provenance.
scenarios.critical_fail: Unsafe exercise prescription, unsupervised hazardous activity, privacy disclosure or misleading health claim.

scenarios.title: Create a visual story with a live reading
scenarios.brief: Develop a short original visual sequence and perform a brief narration. Test composition through thumbnails, apply readable layout and contrast, rehearse pacing and record audience interpretation.
scenarios.evidence: Compare intended focal path and audience interpretation; cite or identify all external visual/audio references and permissions.
scenarios.critical_fail: Uncredited copyrighted assets, non-consensual use of another person’s likeness or forced public disclosure.

scenarios.title: Independent preparation for a supervised meal and appointment day
scenarios.brief: Plan a simple supervised meal and a guardian-approved familiar appointment/journey. Build checklists that communicate sequence, hygiene, safe delegation and contingency information.
deliverables: appointment preparation sheet using fictional data
brief reflection on asking for help
scenarios.evidence: Demonstrate only age-appropriate supervised tasks; inspect clarity and privacy of the documents; explain what must be escalated to an adult.
scenarios.critical_fail: Unsafe food handling, unsupervised sharp/hot equipment, exposure of live location or personal documents.
